kills.property: After calling SetMinSum, MinSum must equal the supplied _val parameter, provided initialization has not yet occurred.
kills.change_summary: Replace the line that assigns _val to MinSum with a constant assignment (MinSum = 0), so that after SetMinSum completes, MinSum will always be 0 regardless of input.

kills.property: SetMinSum can always be called without reverting after Initialized is called, even before initialization.
kills.change_summary: Add an early return before MinSum is set

kills.property: SetLogFile does not revert when intitalized is false and does revert when intitalized is true.
kills.change_summary: Replace `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(!intitalized)revert();`, which inverts the initialization guard, allowing SetLogFile to be called only after initialization — altering when the LogFile state variable can be set.
